Building your future at Pangea

Working at Pangea

Take a giant leap forward into the dynamic world of digital transformation

At Pangea Your Ideas Matter!

We believe our team members are motivated the most when we empower them to work on things they are passionate about.

That is why we try very hard to give as much autonomy as possible and listen to what our team members have to say.

Making Innovation a Reality
Don't Get Left Behind...


Pangea is growing as we continue to make an impact in dozens of countries worldwide. Now is the time to get involved, solving actual problems for millions of people by developing real-world digital transformation solutions.

We Hire People Who
Like to Solve Problems

If your idea of a great job includes solving complex problems, overcoming technology limitations and getting the job done while working in a friendly , supportive environment then you have come to the right place. Send us an email, we would like to get to know you.

Diversity and Inclusion
are Part of Our Culture

Pangea actively promotes an inclusive company culture. Our technology solutions need to meet the daily needs of all our customers from diverse cultures. We believe that when our technology reflects the diversity of the people who use it, everyone can achieve more.

We Are a "People Company".
Come Join Us!

Pangea is “people company” and and we are looking for smart, motivated people to join our team. At Pangea we value the work, dedication and effort of our team so If you are looking for your next career move, then give us a call, we would like to talk to you.
